releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.9 — Authentic Telegram Polish, In-App Media Picker, Matrix Reaction Grid & Delivery Engine Overhaul
releaseNotes:
• Delivery Status Bug Fix: Sent messages strictly display a single grey check (SENT) until verified received or read. Zero false blue ticks when the recipient is offline.
• Telegram In-App Media Picker: Dedicated bottom sheet with 3-column device camera roll grid, live camera tile, numbered circular badges (1, 2, 3), HD toggle, and status upload fix.
• Telegram 2D Matrix Grid: Reaction popup features a 7x4 matrix grid showing 28 top emojis immediately without scrolling.
• Unboxed Inline Reactions: Removed enclosing cards and borders; bare emoji counters sit directly beside the timestamp and delivery checks.
• Theme & Wallpaper Studio Persistence: All 5 ATalkThemeId palettes with color swatches and encrypted VaultManager wallpaper pattern/opacity persistence.
• Notification Sound Studio: 5 customizable sound themes with live audio preview buttons and dynamic channel binding.
• Kinetic Lightbox & Frosted Blur: Telephoto pinch-to-zoom & spring drag-to-dismiss photo viewer with Haze real-time acrylic backdrop blur.
